prompt:
You are a senior ML researcher generating candidates only; do NOT rank, reject, assert novelty, or declare publishability. Return exactly one JSON object shaped {"shard_id":"lens:temporal-evidence-graph","candidates":[{"kind":"idea","title":...,"method_steps":[...],"falsifiable_hypothesis":...,"minimum_experiment":...,"contribution_type":...,"risk":...,"effort":...,"closest_prior_families":[...],"so_what":...,"dedup_key":...}]} with 6-8 candidates.
Direction: design a publishable multi-agent architecture for causal online capacitor degradation forecasting (capacity, ESR, SOH, RUL) using LLM API agents combined with small numerical forecasting/prognostic models. Accuracy on unseen capacitors is the first priority. Every candidate must respect strict rolling-origin, delayed label maturity, LOCO/cross-condition tests, no future leakage, numeric scoring, and failure-safe fallback. The architecture—not mere application—must be the research focus.
Landscape constraints: generic LLM model routing/ensemble is already covered by REATS (arXiv:2608.10149); fast numerical prior + slow LLM/reflection by CastFSR/CastFlow; role-specialized agentic forecasting and memory by CastFlow (2604.27840); macro/micro agents by Nexus (2605.14389); modality debate by TS-Debate (2601.19151); dynamic multi-agent graph selection by DynaSwarm (2507.23261) and MasRouter (2502.11133); graph orchestration by AGORA (2505.24354); last-mile revisions/memory by 2606.02497. Avoid simply repeating those.
Lens: temporal evidence graphs, delayed outcomes/censoring, prequential memory, graph engineering, immutable prediction/maturity ledgers, and value-of-information agent activation. Seek architectural mechanisms whose necessity can be numerically ablated. Moderate compute only; no subjective LLM scoring.
